verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers physical/virtual corporate cards plus multi-currency accounts (USD/EUR/GBP/CAD) with real-time FX conversion and claims of competitive/mid-market rates and no transfer/wire fees, which supports low-fee spending abroad, but there is no explicit mention of ATM cash withdrawals or a specific guarantee against foreign transaction fees on card purchases. Missing for 10: explicit cash withdrawal/ATM support abroad, explicit no-foreign-transaction-fee statement for card spend, independent confirmation of actual FX rates charged.
